content.title: Authenticate to the banking application
content.description: A predefined persona can use the login page to enter username and password, optionally use password visibility and Remember me controls, submit Sign In, and either establish the correct authenticated session for an active credential or receive an understandable failure or locked-state outcome without being granted normal access, with session identity preserved and partially authenticated states avoided.
content.summary: Sign in with a predefined banking persona
content.value: Establishes the correct authenticated boundary and persona-specific banking experience without granting unauthorized access.
criteria: login page presents username, password, password visibility, Remember me, Sign In, and Forgot password controls
seven predefined credential fixtures are exposed: standard_user, locked_user, frozen_user, overdraft_user, slow_user, error_user, and admin_user
each credential fixture produces the product state represented by its description

content.title: End an authenticated session
content.description: An authenticated user can log out so that the active session is terminated, protected banking content stops being actionable as authenticated content, and the product returns cleanly to a non-authenticated state rather than leaving residual access behind.
content.value: Protects banking data and operations by cleanly ending authenticated access.
criteria: logout terminates the session and makes protected banking content non-actionable as authenticated content

content.title: Access the administrative banking view
content.description: An admin_user can authenticate into the administrative experience, see administrative information and controls that are distinct from ordinary customer-facing banking information, and exercise only those capabilities authorized for the administrative persona while standard users remain excluded from admin-only access.
content.value: Exposes role-specific administrative data and controls only to authorized administrators.
criteria: administrative information and controls are distinct from ordinary customer-facing banking information
administrative view and capabilities are restricted to the admin persona and are not inherited by standard users

content.title: Transfer money between accounts
content.description: An authenticated user can perform a supported transfer when the current user and account state permits it by selecting a source account, selecting a destination account, entering a monetary amount that passes product validation and sufficient-funds or overdraft rules, and completing the transfer so that frozen users are blocked, failed attempts do not leave partial updates, successful transfers update both balances consistently, and exposed transaction history reflects the committed movement.
content.value: Moves funds while preserving account, permission, and transaction integrity.
criteria: a transfer identifies a source account, a destination account, and a monetary amount
transfer completion follows supported balance or overdraft rules and frozen users cannot perform transfers
failed transfers are atomic, and successful transfers update both balances and transaction history consistently

content.title: Add funds to an account
content.description: Where the live Bank Demo exposes deposit, add-funds, or equivalent balance-increase functionality, an authenticated user can initiate that funding action with a monetary amount that obeys the product's numeric and business rules, commit the increase to the correct balance, have the result reflected in transaction history where supported, and avoid false balances or completed transactions when the operation fails.
content.value: Supports balance increases without corrupting account or transaction state.
criteria: supported users can initiate the product's balance-increase operation and the amount must obey accepted numeric and business rules
successful funding updates the correct balance and transaction history, while failed funding does not create a false balance or completed transaction

content.title: View a role-appropriate banking dashboard
content.description: After a successful active-user login, an authenticated user reaches the banking overview that reflects the current persona, presents or links to relevant accounts, balances, and transaction/activity information, stays consistent with underlying committed state, and differentiates ordinary versus administrative experiences while still rendering the intended persona-specific behavior for exceptional states the product exposes.
content.value: Gives users a consistent overview of their banking state and available banking areas.
criteria: the dashboard exposes persona context plus relevant accounts, balances, and transaction or activity information, directly or through navigation
administrative users receive a distinct role-aware view, and locked, frozen, overdraft, slow-loading, and error-oriented personas receive their intended state-specific experience

content.title: Manage banking accounts
content.description: An authenticated user can view the accounts available to the current user, distinguish each account by displayed identity and type information, see balances and special account states consistently across product surfaces, and, where the live product supports creation, provide required account information, pass validation, create an account, and have it remain available according to the application's persistence model.
content.value: Lets users inspect and, where supported, create accounts while keeping account data accurate and consistent.
criteria: account management covers listing, identity, balance, creation where supported, validation, persistence, special states, and cross-surface consistency
account data includes identifier or name, type, current balance, status, associated user, and transaction history where supported

content.title: Review transaction history
content.description: An authenticated user can view supported transaction or activity information associated with the current banking state, including each transaction's amount, direction, and relevant account association, and rely on the history to represent only committed financial changes, reconcile with displayed balances, persist according to the product model, and avoid misleading completed records when an operation is rejected.
content.value: Makes financial activity observable and reconcilable with account balances.
criteria: transaction details include amount, money-in versus money-out direction where relevant, relevant account association, and completed-state representation only for committed financial changes
completed transactions reconcile with balances, transaction history persists according to the application model, and rejected operations do not create misleading completed records

content.title: Review loan information
content.description: Where the product exposes loan information, an authenticated or administrative user can view the relevant loan or account context and the current user's loan total, including the intentional wrong-loan-total state for error_user, with the loan view staying internally consistent with supporting data in the same view and without corrupting unrelated balances or transactions.
content.summary: View loan totals and their intentional error state
content.value: Surfaces loan-related totals, including the intentional wrong-loan-total fixture, without corrupting unrelated banking data.
criteria: loan views identify the relevant loan or account context and display a loan total according to the current user's state
error_user exposes the intentionally incorrect loan-total state, while unrelated account balances and transactions remain unaffected

props.quote:
Account management is a core product domain. The product should allow the authenticated user to interact with
supported banking accounts and maintain accurate account-level state.

ACCT-01 Account listing The user can view the accounts available to the current user.
ACCT-02 Account identity Each account is distinguishable by its displayed name/identifier and any supported
account type information.
ACCT-03 Account balance Each account exposes a current balance consistent with committed financial operations.
ACCT-04 Account creation Where the live product provides account creation, an authenticated user can provide the
required account information and create an account.
ACCT-05 Account validation Required account fields are validated before an invalid account can be committed.
ACCT-06 Account persistence A successfully created account remains available according to the application's
persistence model.

ACCT-07 Account state Special states such as frozen or overdraft must be reflected accurately in account
behavior and displayed state.
ACCT-08 Account consistency The same account must not display contradictory balances or identity information across
product surfaces.
